kind: periodic player check-in claiming during paid replenishment
unit: simulated online seconds, resources, soldiers, bone and hide
limits: The input is a selected historically paid late-game checkpoint, not a fresh player population or random win-rate sample.
Every loss is replenished to the historical 626-deployed roster using actual production, costs, training and formation actions.
The player checks the currently displayed offers once per configured online interval; no automatic purchase occurs. At the end they check once more and spend up to five stored manual refresh charges.

Different purchases can alter production timing and the shared RNG stream; pairedBattles reports exact matches to P343, and unmatched battles must not be interpreted as a trade-driven combat improvement.
The clock advances through online tick; offline, Android and reset boundaries are not tested.
The bounded battle horizon cannot establish level-60 reachability or long-term profit.
